scenario_1_spad_investigation.query: Investigate safety events for Train 12414 near Suratgarh on 2026-11-18.
scenario_1_spad_investigation.summary: Train 12414 (Mandore Express, Loco WAP-7 30452) experienced a severe near-SPAD incident approaching Suratgarh Junction at 03:14:15. At 03:11:05, Station Master advised Down Loop Line and Home Signal at RED. Between 03:14:02 and 03:14:30, Loco Pilot Rajesh Kumar was distracted by personal mobile phone usage (Locate AI Alert LOC-20261118-001, confirmed by Reviewer DSO-BKN). Assistant Loco Pilot shouted emergency warning at 03:14:15. Emergency brake applied at 03:14:24; train halted safely 60 meters before the Home Signal at Danger.

timestamp_citations.event: SM advises Caution Order 30 kmph, Home Signal RED.
LP mobile phone distraction detected (28s duration, 94% conf). Reviewer Status: CONFIRMED by DSO-BKN.
ALP Amit Singh shouts: 'सामने होम सिग्नल लाल है! फोन रखिए! ब्रेक लगाइए!'
Emergency RS Valve tripped; BP drops to 0 kg/cm².
Train halted safely 60m before Home Signal. SPAD averted.

scenario_1_spad_investigation.root_cause: Driver inattention and rule violation (personal mobile phone usage in active cab) leading to delayed brake application approaching a stop signal.

scenario_2_fatigue_pattern.query: Show driver alertness and fatigue trends between 02:00 and 05:00 AM on Bikaner Division.
scenario_2_fatigue_pattern.summary: Analysis of Locate CVVRS alerts on Bikaner Division identifies a concentrated cluster of driver micro-sleep infractions (4 confirmed incidents) strictly occurring between 03:30 AM and 04:45 AM. All incidents occurred on long-distance night freight trains (BOXN-542, BOXN-611) and express run 14707. No fatigue violations occurred during day shifts (06:00 - 18:00).
corrective_actions: Mandate audio vigilance confirmation intervals reduced from 60s to 30s during 02:00 - 05:00 AM window.
Conduct surprise breathalyzer and alertness checks at Lalgarh and Suratgarh crew lobbies.
